name: berlin-cinema-app
description: Frontend app for Berlin Cinema API

scripts.admin: npm run build && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/admin.ts
scripts.test:contracts: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/ingestion-contract.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json src/services/movie-data.test.ts
scripts.test:resolution: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json shared/text-normalization.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/identity-evidence.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/resolution.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/detail-history.test.ts
scripts.test:pipeline: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/pipeline.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/venue-websites.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/film-screening-evidence.test.ts && npm run test:resolution && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:sources && npm run test:resilience && npm run test:rollout
scripts.test:rollout: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/migrate-ingestion.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/compare-ingestion.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/rollout.test.ts && npm run test:state
scripts.test: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/tmdb-client.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/omdb-client.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/osm-client.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/berlin-de-scraper.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/audit-log.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/merge.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/sync-data.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json scripts/scrape.test.ts && npm run test:pipeline
scripts.test:sources: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/film-metadata.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/registry.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/adapters.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/progress.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/detail-cache.test.ts
scripts.test:resilience: ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/rejected-scope.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/scoped-refresh.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/run-recovery.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/pipeline/publication-root.test.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json api/sources/resilience.test.ts
